battery.nominal_voltage_class.notes: Estimated: The 78 kWh Polestar 2 pack is the same CMA 108-cell NMC pack as the Volvo XC40 Recharge 78 kWh (EV Database: 400 V); the Polestar US spec page confirms 400 V for the later 82 kWh pack.

battery.preconditioning.notes: Estimated: Polestar 2 manual (US, 2024): "When charging stations have been added in Google Maps, the battery will be preconditioned to reduce charging time." No manual control mentioned. The manual describes only the navigation trigger but does not state there is no manual control (the 2023 manual refers to "selecting preconditioning"), so the closest enum is used.

dc_max_kw.notes: InsideEVs (Polestar US 2024): Dual Motor 78 kWh, up to 155 kW. EV Database (European 2024 dual, 82 kWh pack) differs; North American 2024 dual kept 78 kWh per EPA/Polestar.

ac_max_kw.notes: Estimated: 11 kW per the US 2023 Polestar 2 manual; same onboard charger in 2024.

published_10_80_min.notes: InsideEVs (Polestar US 2024): Dual Motor about 34 min 10-80% at up to 155 kW.

charge_port.notes: Estimated: North American Polestar 2 has a CCS1 port: Polestar Canada sells a NACS-to-CCS1 adapter for the Polestar 2 and the US checker lists Polestar as a paid adapter, so there is no native NACS port. Applies to 2024; no port change found across 2021-2025.
Estimated: The Charge Port 2026 US checker lists Polestar 2 (2021-2025) as CCS1 (adapter needed for Superchargers).

supercharger_access.notes: Polestar Canada: Polestar 2 is compatible with the NACS adapter (ordered via a Polestar Service Point).
US: Polestar 2 owners can order the NACS adapter ($230) through Service Points (Polestar official quoted by InsideEVs).
